name: Bayesian cumulative cross-validation
model_likelihood: Parameterized sampling family f_theta with likelihood integrated over theta; not restricted to linear regression.
prior: Specified parameter prior pi(theta); subjective priors are allowed in the preparatory-training construction.
inference_algorithm: Uniformly sample training/test splits; compute joint log posterior predictives exactly when tractable or estimate using posterior Monte Carlo draws.
estimand: S_CCV(y_1:n;P), the cumulative exhaustive leave-p-out score summed over p=1,...,P.
data_input: Observed data y_1:n; candidate likelihood and prior; training/test partitions.
tunable_settings: Maximum holdout size P (preparatory size n-P); Monte Carlo split count T; posterior draw count B; candidate prior and its hyperparameters.
